input_recipe.cloud: unique original quadratic-boundary FEM IDs; BLAKE2b seed2026:CAD without replacement; zero padding/bool mask
input_recipe.support_flags: actual RBE2 CM on mapped members and actual SPC; no role-implied clamping
input_recipe.material: explicit real MAT1 E/nu/rho; no defaults

reader_scope.coordinates: GRID CP=CD=0 after actual GRDSET expansion; explicit zero overrides default; nonzero systems unsupported
reader_scope.material: All CTETRA mapped through PSOLID to one validated isotropic MAT1; E>0,-1<nu<0.5; explicitG consistency relative1e-8
reader_scope.constraints: Initial specialization: every support RBE2 master constrained123456=0; CM includes123; member translations derived zero. Direct123 zero SPC/PS supported. No unrestrained master, nonzero prescribed motion or unsupported constraint algebra
reader_scope.reduction: u=Tz with free-node identity blocks and exact derived-zero supported translations; no role-flag constraints
reader_scope.rbe3: One loaded reference, translational member Ci=123, positive actual weights, no UM; published weighted-LS rigid-fit is an explicit new approximation
reader_scope.control_policy: Parse all small/free-field cards. Record explicitly allowlisted output/static-irrelevant controls. Do not reproduce original numerical/integration/autoconstraint settings. Unknown active material/load/constraint/contact cards cause an explicit unsupported result
reader_scope.grid_ids: Actual canonical GRID IDs map to original H5 rows; no ID-1 assumption or nearest-node remapping
reader_scope.ctetra_check: Every cached cell covered by deck CTETRA/material, preserving full corner-midpoint edge associations
reader_scope.parameter_semantics: POST/output record-only. AUTOSPC is not reproduced: no automatic constraints; unsupported free zero-energy DOFs rejected. CHECKEL NO recorded but own mathematical guards retained. RENUMOK YES recorded without input resequencing or geometry repair. PRINFACC 1 output only. CONTFEL AUTO and GAPCMPL NO excluded only under this no-contact/no-gap-element specialization; unknown active contact cards rejected. GAPCMPL NO does not disable contact. Unselected modal METHOD/EIGRL preserved but excluded; selected static METHOD rejected. Exact DEBUG LGSHPSNS 0.0 explicitly not reproduced with original effect unknown. No OptiStruct numerical/integration equivalence claim.

scientific.old_TRAIN40_reuse: Existing original TRAIN120 input/scaler; no new scaler fit
scientific.DEV20_reuse: Existing target-free input records only; no rereading GT for preparation

recipe_reference.learning_rate_schedule: constant; existing shared recipe retained to isolate exposure and coverage
recipe_reference.loss: All original case nodes, encoded4 MSE; one full-case mean and one Adam update; weighted chunks only for pointwise models; whole global context for transformer
recipe_reference.case_order: For each scale, independent complete shuffles of its full CAD×known3 list using Python Random(2026); identical stored order across all five methods at that scale; 4800 always full passes
recipe_reference.budget_clock: Accumulated whole-case update wall time including case IO and synchronized forward/backward/Adam; excludes separate initialization, evaluation and checkpoint writes which are separately reported
recipe_reference.budget_stop_rule: Check only between complete-case updates, retain partial pass and actual exposures. If 4800 not reached, terminal incomplete_cost_limit, never equate insufficient exposure with converged architecture failure
recipe_reference.second_seed: not part of this macro comparison; no variance/significance claim
recipe_reference.capacity: Reuse exact existing family constructors/presets; capacities differ and are disclosed. This measures current recipe, not tuned family optima
recipe_reference.fno_query: Trilinearly query encoded4 at all original nodes, then physical decode; grid contains inputs only
recipe_reference.transolver_pp_evaluation: Pinned upstream stochastic Gumbel behavior; deterministic per-case checkpoint-specific isolated RNG; preserve train RNG
recipe_reference.continuous_query_scope: Original-node U/S primary; this stage alone does not certify arbitrary interior query/gradient quality or full engineering qualification

runtime_requirements: A separately frozen budget and one-shot guard must authorize any actual CUDA preparation
The guard must wait for current training/readout/diagnostic GPU work to end and use the common lock
Use target-free InputLedger, which rejects known3_U_S and all target counters
Check every prepared record has exactly the input members and no physical_path/target_path
Attach scientific_CAD_roles; do not treat the helper validation alias as DEV or TRAIN
All fixed80 inputs must succeed or preserve a whole-input negative; no substitutions
TRAIN numeric target preparation requires a separate TRAIN-only frozen stage
FINAL numerical targets remain sealed until all selected full60 predictions or failures are submitted
limitations: Existing source stats and reception SHA bind files; raw bytes have not been reread here
No runtime input shape, whole80 preparation, off-node accuracy or model result is proved
Availability-conditional official TRAIN pool; not official TEST or demonstrated shape-family separation
